home: Nemetra—has never left, refuses to, sees leaving as betrayal of the sick and dying who need her
appearance: Late 60s, weathered face with deep lines, sharp grey eyes that miss nothing, faded green shawl, earth-stained hands, walks with carved hazelwood staff, wears dried herb bundles at belt
wants: Truth about northern woods threat, village to take danger seriously, protect the younger herb-wives
does_not_want: Militia interference, fools dismissing her warnings, goblins harmed before she learns what they know
oddly_also: Heavy smoker (pipe, strong tobacco) despite it damaging her lungs—considered unfeminine, she doesn't care
family: House Yebrin (distant cousin), 6 herb-wives under her guidance, no living children
self_image: Proud of her humility, quietly smug about being right when others are wrong
recreation: Smoking her pipe on the compound steps at dusk, watching village life
dreams: Establish Nemetra as tobacco exporter, prove herb-wives' wisdom to the fools, die respected
anecdotes: Delivered Captain Durvin himself during a winter storm—he was blue when he came out, she breathed life back into him. He's never thanked her once.
Diagnosed House Halbet's pottery master with lung rot from kiln smoke 20 years ago—he ignored her, kept working, died within the year. His son listens now.
Once talked down a delirious wounded orc at the forest edge using only hand signs and offering him water. Militia wanted to kill it. She sent it limping north with bandaged leg.
tragedies: Lost all three of her children (two daughters, one son) to fever in a single week during Year 285. She knows every herb that might have saved them—none grew close enough in time.
Her husband left her 40 years ago, said she 'loved plants more than people.' He remarried in Tagmira. She never speaks of him but keeps his tobacco pouch.

Her mentor, Old Kessa, was killed by militiamen who thought she was consorting with fey (she was gathering moonlit herbs). Yaleth found the body. Durvin's father led that patrol—she's never forgotten.
pc_leverage: Bring her proof of northern woods threat, protect goblins from militia, share intelligence she can't gather herself, respect her knowledge
